B.name: Jedaiah
B.line: Second priestly course-head named Jedaiah in Jeshua's list, house later headed by Nethaneel

why: The Hebrew לִידַעְיָה נְתַנְאֵל identifies Nethaneel as the representative of Jedaiah’s priestly house, immediately after Hilkiah’s entry. This matches B’s stated identity as the second Jedaiah course-head whose house was later headed by Nethaneel.
